original_source.title: William Lilly, Christian Astrology (London: Thomas Brudenell, 1647)

713.observed: Degree conversion table: original YEARS column explicitly carries from 68y 364d0h at 68° to 70y 4d3h at 69°. Rows 69–90 increment original printed years by one over their degree label.

714.observed: Minute conversion table: 27′ label omitted between 26′ and 28′; 8′ printed 44d 10h; 60′ printed 374d 14h. The 11°55′ worked example begins on this page.

715.observed: Worked examples conclude 12y33d14h for 11°55′ and twenty years 57 days 21 hours for 19°52′.

modern_2003_witness.label: WorldAstrology retypeset Lilly Christian Astrology Book III (2003)
modern_2003_witness.warning: Retypeset source preserved separately; not silently corrected.

year_69.type: year-carry differs; original 1647 explicit carry removes 2003 retype's artificial one-year error.

degree_years_69_to_90.original_col: original column displays Years=Degrees+1 at degrees 69–90
degree_years_69_to_90.note: Day/hour columns are reused from 2003, with spot-checks on 1647 page; not a full independent cell-level collation.

worked_19_52.computed_intermediate: 19 years + 422 days + 21 hours = 20 years + 57 days + 21 hours (365-day year).
worked_19_52.type: 2003 retype conclusion error, not a verified original Lilly error.

shared_or_partially_checked_anomalies.minute27: Row label 27' absent in both 1647 photograph and 2003 retype.
shared_or_partially_checked_anomalies.minute8: 44d 10h at 8' visible in original, not just the 2003 witness; suspicious relative to adjacent values; not corrected.
shared_or_partially_checked_anomalies.minute60: 374d 14h printed at 60′ on original image, inconsistent with 1° row (1y5d8h using 365-day year).
shared_or_partially_checked_anomalies.degree80_hour24: Original photo visually reads the unusual 24h value at 80°, matching retype; held as raw.
shared_or_partially_checked_anomalies.minute44: 2003 value 271d8h; digit detail in first-edition photo is faint; requires higher resolution before asserting exact match.

remaining.full_collation: Independently inspect EVERY original degree/minute day+hour cell against 2003 retyping at higher resolution, especially faint columns.
remaining.additional_scans: Compare a second independently held 1647 copy if warranted; distinguish source original printing from digital image artifacts.
remaining.timing: Other time keys require independent historical computational specification and original witness.
